title: Galen, ›On Demonstration‹
summary: This volume collects Greek and Arabic testimonia of the lost On Demonstration by Galen of Pergamum (129–c. 216). The texts are accompanied by notes, English translation, and a substantive introduction. The treatise was a study of method in natural science which made a significant impact on Arabic philosophy. What remains of it is an exciting source for the history of natural science, logic, and scientific writing.
